description: Say that outcomes in different documents of one Space are one outcome. The link changes no text in any document: it keeps the outcomes in one row when a title changes. Use it when the reader asks to link outcomes, or names two that are the same. An outcome that is in a link already brings the rest of that link with it. Needs the owner or editor role.

documentId.description: The document that holds the outcome.

entityId.description: The outcome id inside that document, from spaces_list_outcomes.

name: spaces_link_outcomes
title: Link outcomes that are the same
